subject: HOUSE
text: Using a House restores 120 HP to all warriors and prompts saving, but due to a bug spell charges are restored only after saving, requiring a subsequent Tent or Cabin save to preserve restored magic upon reload.

evidence.quote:
HOUSE	3000	all warriors recover 120 HP, and then the option to save the
		  game is given; if the game was saved, all warriors then
		  recover all of their SL charges(nC)*...*BUG: magic is not restored until after the game is saved, so the benefits
	of using the HOUSE are not saved;  if you reload the game, it will
	go back to the point before all SL charges were restored, and thus
	you will have wasted a HOUSE.  To avoid this, save the game twice by
	using a TENT or CABIN immediately after using the HOUSE.
